title: Abaddon's Cipher
html: Abaddon's Ciphers found in the Storeroom 1A Cellar and Storeroom 4A Cellar below the Storerooms off of the Embercore Path. They sleep in Sensory Deprivation Chambers which look very much like sepulchres. In Storeroom 1A they are Searing Geists Champions and one Hero. In Storeroom 4A they are Blood Mystics.
